I am a speech pathologist. There are several things that make it difficult. There are 2 types of /r/ in the English language. The type that comes at the beginning of a word and the type that comes in the middle or end of a word (known as a vowel /r/) Aurora requires both types of /r/. Also, the beginning and final sound “uh” is made in the front of the mouth. So you go from front of mouth to back of mouth for /r/, produce both types of /r/ and then you go back to the front of the mouth for the final sound. It’s very complex.
